forcedChoices.reason: The feminine «las órdenes» reads first as 'commands'; masculine is the sense of category.
The noun «Estrella» is feminine, but the first-born of Nebadon is Gabriel, a male being; the masculine noun stands for the being.

forcedChoices.choice: «divergente» after «la técnica del ciclo de la eternidad»
forcedChoices.reason: The English 'divergent' can modify the technique or the cycle; «divergente» has one form for both genders and keeps both readings open.

forcedChoices.choice: «la jefa de los serafines de Urantia ... ella»
forcedChoices.reason: The English uses 'she' for this chief; the feminine noun keeps that.
The text speaks to the reader; the packet rule asks for the plural «ustedes».
Agreement with the feminine noun «Significaciones»; it states no gender of the beings.

forcedChoices.choice: «confianza» for 'trust' in both senses (faith placed in a person and a charge entrusted); «cargos de confianza» for the plural 'trusts'
forcedChoices.reason: Spanish «confianza» does not take the sense of an entrusted charge in the plural, so the plural needs a noun of office.
